title: On the Minute - A
texts:  On the Minute - A Premium Workout
3 pull ups x 5 sets - on the minute

Perform 5 sets of 3 pull ups, resting 1 minute between sets.

If you can complete 5 sets of 3 reps at body weight, add weight to increase the intensity.   You may also perform the reps more slowly.

To decrease the overall intensity, reduce the volume of sets or reps.  If you are unable to complete 5 sets of 3 reps, use a band or pulley system for assistance.
